title: REQ · Texture keys resolve through resolveTextureKey with a fallback texture
summary: Fallback texture generated at runtime and used for missing or failed assets
description: Context: effectContext passes spec.asset directly to Phaser particles. Desired: BootScene generates a fallback texture keyed by FALLBACK_ASSET_ID, records ids whose load fails, and resolves every key via resolveTextureKey. Why: missing assets must not crash or show Phaser's missing texture.
acceptance_criteria: Given an id absent from the manifest, when resolved, then the fallback key is returned
Given a loaderror for an id, when resolved, then the fallback key is returned
Given a dust effect with a missing asset, when created, then particles use the fallback key

in_scope: BootScene fallback generation and loaderror handling

technical_constraints: FALLBACK_ASSET_ID from @game/assets/loaders/manifestLoader must not pull in node fs at runtime: define key via a literal 'fallback:missing' in BootScene
